v1.0.0
 * Require Python 3.11+ and Sphinx 9.0+
 * Rename the domain from csharp to cs
 * Rename the method directive to function, and value to enumerator
 * Support documenting C# APIs generated by Doxygen with Breathe
 * Add struct, interface, var and event directives
 * Add the obj role for referencing any object type
 * Parse generic methods, nullable types, pointers and multi-dimensional arrays
 * Link built-in and System types to the Microsoft docs, configurable with sphinx_csharp_* options
 * Resolve references by the closest enclosing namespace
 * Add C# objects to the general index
 * Show invalid signatures as written instead of crashing
 * Support parallel builds
 * Ship type hints (py.typed)

v0.1.8
 * Use _() instead of l_() function, which will be removed in Sphinx 3
 * Drop support for Sphinx 1.4 and 1.5 as they don't support _() correctly

v0.1.7
 * Added inherits directive (#5)
 * Drop support for Python 2.6
 * Add support for Python 3.6 and 3.7

v0.1.6
 * Allow default values in method signatures to contain brackets

v0.1.5
 * Support Sphinx >= 1.3
 * Fix future deprecation in Sphinx 1.7
 * Make code pep8 and pylint conformant

v0.1.4
 * Add support for parameter modifiers and indexers

v0.1.3
 * Add namespace directive

v0.1.2
 * Add support for generic classes and methods
 * Add support for attributes

v0.1.1
 * Add support for constructors

v0.1.0
 * Initial version
